# betterado_pipeline_run (Data Source)

Reads a Pipelines v2 run (`_apis/pipelines/{id}/runs/{runId}`) from Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_pipeline_run" "example" {
  project_id  = data.betterado_project.example.id
  pipeline_id = 42
  run_id      = 1001
}

output "run_state" {
  value = data.betterado_pipeline_run.example.state
}

output "run_result" {
  value = data.betterado_pipeline_run.example.result
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_id` (Number) The integer ID of the pipeline this run belongs to.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the pipeline run belongs to.
- `run_id` (Number) The integer ID of the pipeline run.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) The creation date/time of the run in RFC3339 format.
- `finished_date` (String) The finish date/time of the run in RFC3339 format. Empty if the run has not yet finished.
- `id` (String) The run ID as a string (set as the data source ID).
- `name` (String) The name (run number) of the pipeline run.
- `result` (String) The result of the run. One of: `unknown`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `canceled`. Empty if the run has not yet completed.
- `state` (String) The state of the run. One of: `unknown`, `inProgress`, `canceling`, `completed`.
